title: Enhanced Payment Flow, Better Session Management & Smarter Driver Status!
subtitle: Here's what's new in this update:
highlights: In-app payment browser - pay your remittance without leaving the app
2-year session persistence - stay logged in longer without re-entering credentials
Driver status improvements - can't go online with active rides, loading indicator during status change
Fixed booking price updates - amount refreshes correctly when you change pickup/destination
Clean booking state - 'Book Ride' button resets after successful booking
App crash fixes - better error handling for realtime subscriptions
Fixed rider logout - no more 404 screen when logging out
Enhanced cashback - rewards marked as used only after ride is verified
Driver auto-online - automatically goes online after paying overdue remittance
Improved driver location verification with better logging for debugging
